name: Everyday Spending
shortDescription: Groceries, household goods, and retail — learn who actually owns the brands in your basket, then redirect that spending one aisle at a time.

name: Subscriptions
shortDescription: Recurring digital revenue is what moves valuations. Audit every subscription you pay, cancel what you can, and move the rest to providers outside the target set.

name: Money & Banking
tagline: Where your money sleeps at night
shortDescription: Your deposits are working capital that your bank lends and invests. Move them to member-owned institutions and pay on rails that don't route a fee to a US network.

name: Investments
tagline: You may own what you're boycotting
shortDescription: You are probably already funding what you're boycotting. Find out what your pension holds, then decide whether to move it, vote it, or organise around it.

name: Travel
tagline: The one with a public scoreboard
shortDescription: The only category with a public scoreboard — inbound tourism and vehicle registrations are published monthly. Skip the trip, skip the brand, and say why.

name: Institutions
shortDescription: One organisation switching outweighs a thousand individual consumers. Your employer, council, union, club and congregation all sign contracts — and someone has to raise it.

name: Attention
tagline: You're the inventory. Stop supplying it.
shortDescription: Your attention, your posts and your data are the product these platforms sell. Withdraw the supply, block the ads, and fund the alternative with what you save.
